overview: Helix Systems is an internal company data explorer for a software/robotics company, displaying 15 datasets across a dashboard and allowing JSON data uploads.
features: Company overview dashboard with key metric stat cards
Products and offices display on the main dashboard
15 datasets stored and queryable from the backend
Data upload panel with file drop zone for JSON files
Live record count display after upload
Pre-populated sample data with realistic company records
SVG double helix logo and professional corporate design
Sidebar navigation between Dashboard and Upload Data
